selection_reasoning: These three tasks form a coherent exploration and mining sequence in a cave/underground environment. The player must first locate andesite (a common stone variant that signals they are in the right underground area), then mine a lapis block (which requires being in the correct underground zone and having the right tool), and finally find magenta_glazed_terracotta (a decorative block placed deeper in the cave as a reward/goal). The dependency chain is: finding andesite confirms the player is in the mining area, which leads them toward the lapis block to mine, and after mining they continue exploring to find the magenta_glazed_terracotta. This creates a natural exploration → mining → discovery progression.

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The andesite wall is at spawn-relative (-2, 0-3, -1 to 0), only ~2 blocks from spawn on the left wall. Target is the center of the andesite cluster at (-2, 1, 0). Max_distance=5 ensures the player is actually near the andesite (prevents false triggers from across the 14-block corridor). Facing_tolerance=60° confirms the player is looking toward it, modeling 'finding' the block visually.

Uses inventory_has because this is a mine task and the mined drop ends up in inventory. CRITICAL MINECRAFT MECHANIC: Block of Lapis Lazuli (lapis_block) drops ITSELF when mined with any pickaxe — it does NOT drop lapis_lazuli items (that's lapis_ore behavior only). The player has an iron pickaxe provided at spawn. There are 3 lapis blocks at (5,0,4), (5,1,4), and (6,0,4). Mining at least one puts lapis_block in inventory.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The magenta glazed terracotta is at spawn-relative (10, 0-1, 6) at the far end of the corridor (~12 blocks from spawn). Target is (10, 1, 6) at eye level. Max_distance=8 ensures the player has actually walked toward the far end of the cave rather than triggering from near spawn. Facing_tolerance=60° confirms the player is looking at the distinctive magenta block with its arrow/chevron pattern.

scene_description: A well-lit underground stone corridor with three target blocks placed at increasing distances from spawn. Andesite blocks form the left wall near spawn, lapis blocks are placed in the middle section, and magenta glazed terracotta is at the far end. The player starts with an iron pickaxe for mining.
task_text: Explore this underground cave. First find the andesite blocks near you, then mine the lapis blocks in the middle of the cave, and finally find the magenta glazed terracotta at the far end.
design_notes: Linear corridor ~14 blocks long, 10 blocks wide. Andesite at (-2,0,-1) near spawn left wall. Lapis blocks at (5,0,4) and (6,0,4) in middle. Magenta glazed terracotta at (10,0,6) at far end. CRITICAL: lapis_block drops itself when mined (not lapis_lazuli — that's from ore). Milestone must check for lapis_block in inventory.
